title: Majority Fourier-weight sum bound
statement: For every natural number $k$, the sum of $j$ times the limiting majority Fourier weight at $j$, over $0\leq j\leq k$, satisfies $\sum_{j=0}^{k} j\,w_j\leq 4(2/\pi)^{3/2}\sqrt{k}$, where $w_j$ is the limiting majority Fourier weight at level $j$.
